title: Spyglass: Now Live and Enhanced
summary: The powerful new Spyglass tool has officially launched, providing all users with advanced insights and an optimized experience.

title: Powerful File Management and Display Options
summary: Experience a new level of control within your editor with our latest update, allowing you to easily manage, upload, and customize the display of all your embedded files for a more streamlined content creation process.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Our new public roadmap provides a transparent view of recently shipped features, upcoming updates, and exciting future plans for Noeko.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Our improved checkboxes are now easier to click and drag, and they seamlessly blend with your workspace for a more efficient and delightful experience.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: We've significantly upgraded the collaboration experience, making it easier and more intuitive to work with your team in real-time.

title: Effortless Access to Shared Content
summary: Easily discover and collaborate on shared content with enhanced search capabilities that bring all relevant items to your fingertips.

title: Noeko Embraces Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to announce that Noeko is now open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control and transparency over its future development.

title: Global Language Support
summary: We are thrilled to expand Noeko's reach, offering comprehensive support for a wide array of international languages to users worldwide.

title: Elevated Themes & Fresh Designs
summary: We are enhancing our current themes for a more refined look and introducing exciting new design options to personalize your experience.

title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Your Dynamic Knowledge Map
summary: Explore your entire knowledge base like never before with powerful new filtering capabilities for tags, time, and shared items, transforming your map into a personalized command center for discovery and productivity.

title: Enhanced Search and Curated Collections
summary: Effortlessly navigate and refine your entire knowledge base with powerful new filtering and sorting options, plus the ability to save your custom searches for instant access to curated collections.

title: Intuitive Content Organization
summary: Effortlessly structure your notes and explore related information with new, flexible display modes designed to enhance clarity and interaction.

title: Noeko: Take Control with Self-Hosting and Advanced Plans
summary: Soon, you'll be able to deploy Noeko within your own infrastructure or unlock powerful premium features through our new self-hosting and paid plan options.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're ensuring your homepage always greets you with the correct time of day, making your experience more precise and welcoming.

title: Effortless Tag Organization
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged items with new direct actions in your tag views, enabling you to quickly unapply tags and perform other essential tasks without tedious navigation.

title: Unlock More Content Sources
summary: Seamlessly integrate content from a wider array of sources like YouTube videos, websites, and text files, empowering you to consolidate all your valuable information in one place and enrich your insights.
